title: Operator and Spectral Theory
description: Bounded/unbounded operators, spectra, compact/Fredholm theory, forms, semigroups, and Sturm-Liouville (C01-C14)

declarations.name: Banach Algebra Invertibility and Spectrum
declarations.statement_summary: Neumann series (1-a)^(-1) = sum a^n for ||a|| < 1; resolvent set rho(a) and spectrum sigma(a) is compact and nonempty.

declarations.name: Spectral Radius Formula and Resolvent Identity
declarations.statement_summary: r(T) = lim_{n -> infty} ||T^n||^(1/n) = sup_{lambda in sigma(T)} |lambda|; resolvent identity R(z) - R(w) = (w - z) R(z) R(w).

declarations.name: Compact Linear Operators as a Closed Ideal
declarations.scope_summary: Compact operators K(X, Y) between Banach spaces
declarations.statement_summary: K(X) is a closed two-sided ideal in L(X); norm limits of finite-rank operators are compact.

declarations.name: Riesz-Schauder Theory and Fredholm Alternative
declarations.statement_summary: dim ker(I - K) = dim coker(I - K) < infty; Fredholm index ind(I - K) = 0.

declarations.name: Self-Adjoint, Normal and Unitary Operators
declarations.statement_summary: Adjoint T* defined by <Tx, y> = <x, T*y>; self-adjoint (T = T*) has real spectrum sigma(T) subset R.

declarations.name: Spectral Theorem for Compact Self-Adjoint Operators
declarations.scope_summary: Compact self-adjoint operator on Hilbert space H
declarations.statement_summary: H admits an orthonormal eigenbasis with real eigenvalues converging to zero: T = sum_k lambda_k P_k.

declarations.name: Continuous Functional Calculus for Normal Operators
declarations.scope_summary: Bounded normal operators on Hilbert space
declarations.statement_summary: Isometric *-algebra homomorphism C(sigma(T)) -> L(H) mapping polynomial p(z) to p(T).

declarations.name: Unbounded Operators, Dense Domains and Closed Graphs
declarations.scope_summary: Densely defined operators D(A) subset X -> Y
declarations.statement_summary: A is closed if its graph G(A) is closed; adjoint A* defined densely for symmetric/self-adjoint operators.

declarations.name: Lax-Milgram Theorem for Coercive Sesquilinear Forms
declarations.scope_summary: Coercive bounded forms on Hilbert space H
declarations.statement_summary: If B(u,v) is bounded and coercive (Re B(u,u) >= c ||u||^2), then for every f in H*, exists unique u with B(u,v) = f(v).

declarations.name: C0-Semigroups and Hille-Yosida Generation Theorem
declarations.scope_summary: Strongly continuous semigroups T(t) on Banach space X
declarations.statement_summary: A densely defined closed operator A generates a contraction C0-semigroup iff (0, infty) subset rho(A) and ||R(lambda, A)|| <= 1/lambda.

declarations.name: Stone Theorem on Strongly Continuous Unitary Groups
declarations.scope_summary: Unitary groups U(t) on Hilbert space H
declarations.statement_summary: A group U(t) is strongly continuous unitary iff its generator A = iH where H is densely defined self-adjoint.

declarations.name: Multiplication, Shift and Convolution Operators
declarations.scope_summary: Operators on L^p and sequence spaces
declarations.statement_summary: Pointwise multiplication M_m f = m * f and integral kernel operators (K f)(x) = int k(x,y) f(y) dy.

declarations.name: Singular Values and Pseudospectral Enclosures
declarations.statement_summary: sigma_epsilon(A) = {z in C : ||(zI - A)^(-1)|| > 1/epsilon}; singular value decomposition bounds.

declarations.name: Regular Sturm-Liouville Resolvent and Eigenbasis
declarations.scope_summary: Regular boundary value problem -(p y')' + q y = lambda w y on [a, b]
declarations.statement_summary: Green function yields a compact self-adjoint resolvent; eigenfunctions form a complete orthonormal basis in L^2_w.
